description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/SearchProduct/RemoveListing. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Removes one listing from HGR. HGRWeb uses it to delete pending listings in review or error so they are never published. ReadOnly: false. RequiresConfirmation: true. RequiresChannel: true. Use when: The user explicitly asks to remove or delete a pending listing so it is never published. SearchTerms: remove pending listing, delete pending listing, remove listing from HGR. Input: [FromBody] rq: Request.ListNowRequest. Id is a variation ID of the listing to remove, not its parent ListingId. Resolve the attached product or GetPending listingId through Listing/GetListings with ListingIds and Projection=Identifiers in the selected channel, then use variations[0].id, as HGRWeb Remove does. The whole listing that owns that variation is removed. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId, used to resolve the variation; the endpoint itself does not check it. Output: BaseResponse.Success is true when the listing was marked removed and false when no listing in the authenticated user's stores owns that variation ID. Search terms: searchproduct removelisting. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.

name: hgr_post_searchproduct_removelisting
title: Post Searchproduct Removelisting
